stem: Which sentence from the article suggests that Happy Feet may have become accustomed to living in captivity?

options.label: A
options.text: At first, conservation authorities said they would wait and let nature take its course with the penguin.

options.label: B
options.text: The penguin slipped down the slide on his stomach, bottom first, she said.

options.label: C
options.text: And, perhaps befitting of a bird from the Internet age, those followers will be able to keep track of him for a while longer.

options.label: D
options.text: But when they opened the door of the crate, the penguin showed no interest in leaving.
